items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-6,400 (levels 1-12). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Rule, Ratannia! unlocked. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Cultist Sacrifice. Ultimate (Rule, Ratannia!) is available from Cultist Sacrifice.

items.name: Extended Magazine
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Cultist Sacrifice completes 5,600 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Cultist Sacrifice completes 4.8k weapon in 5600 souls (~5.6 min), 5 purchases
items.legacy_note: Its weapon damage raises your grenade damage.

items.name: Monster Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Cultist Sacrifice completes 4,800 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Cultist Sacrifice completes 4.8k weapon in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Titanic Magazine
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Cultist Sacrifice completes 4,000 souls on. Upgrade of Extended Magazine (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Cultist Sacrifice completes 4.8k weapon in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Fortitude, 6400 souls (~6.4 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Fortitude, 5600 souls (~5.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Cultist Sacrifice
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 46% weapon damage. Upgrade of Monster Rounds (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 6,400-22,400 (levels 12-26). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Scrap Grenade T3, Royal Pestments T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Rat Swarm, damage per bite) grows from 9 to 13.8. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Fortitude, spirit 4.8k at Greater Expansion.

items.name: Extra Health
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Fortitude completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Fortitude completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Fortitude
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Extra Health (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Hollow Point
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 46 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.why: spirit investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Greater Expansion, 8800 souls (~8.8 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Scrap Grenade: takes 18% off its 18s base cooldown.

items.name: Ballistic Enchantment
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 8,000 to 11,200 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage. | Imbued on Scrap Grenade.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: spirit investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Greater Expansion, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 6,400 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k tiers): bonus 19 to 45 spirit power. +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Rule, Ratannia! radius (28m), Scrap Grenade big explosion radius (14m), Scrap Grenade shrapnel sphere radius (8m).

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 22,400-43,200 (levels 26-34). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Rule, Ratannia! T3.

items.name: Battle Vest
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on Scrap Grenade: resets its 18s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown. Takes spirit from 6,400 to 12,800 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 45 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 12,800 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 42 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Colossus
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Battle Vest.
sections.desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Battle Vest.

items.name: Return Fire
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Only if they have a real gun hero: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta, Vyper.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Mo & Krill's Combo.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Stuns and silences that stop your ult.

items.name: Glass Cannon
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 11,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Sell Battle Vest for this, or Hollow Point if a counter took it.

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: On Scrap Grenade. Sell Cultist Sacrifice for this.

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 19,200 to 25,600 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 216s of base cooldown across your kit, 160s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Takes spirit from 12,800 to 16,000 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Replaces Greater Expansion: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
